en: Black‑and‑white view over a small European town in a hilly landscape. Dominating the right side is a large multi‑winged castle or palace on a rise, with towers and steep tiled roofs. In the middle distance stands a tall church with a slender spire and a large adjoining nave. At the left is a multi‑storey industrial building with many identical windows and a tall smokestack. The foreground shows grassy fields and the roofs of smaller houses; one roof in the lower right bears faint painted lettering. The overall composition resembles an early 20th‑century picture postcard of a historic town with a castle and church.
